reading_rules: A figure is a check on days that were already seen. Nothing here is a verdict, nothing is registered and no choice is made on it; (s3c) stays the candidate until she rules on the result.
A gain or loss is read from the 90% interval of mean d excluding zero; otherwise undecided. A point estimate alone is not read.
A pooled figure is never read without the turn-day, other-day and month splits beside it. The pressure figures rest on few days; the page states the counts.
The page says plainly: at full allotment (s3c) gives P(> +10 bp) of at most about 1% by construction, and 0 when the upper quantiles sit on the line.
The page ends with marked questions for Eleonora with numbered options and defaults that change no claim.
